motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Council request the City Attorney to prepare and present an amendment to Los Angeles Municipal Code Section 80.36.1 that would add the following street segments as roadways where it is unlawful to drive vehicles exceeding a maximum gross weight of 6,000 pounds: • Both sides of East 110th Street between Compton Avenue and Graham Avenue. • Both sides of East 111th Street between Compton Avenue and Graham Avenue. • Both sides of East 112th Street between Compton Avenue and Monitor Avenue. • Both sides of East 113th Street between Compton Avenue and Monitor Avenue. • Both sides of East 114th Street between Compton Avenue and Wilmington Avenue. • Entrances off of Compton Avenue on East 111th Street. • Wilmington Avenue entrance off of East 114th Street. I FURTHER MOVE that the Council direct the Department of Transportation to conduct a traffic study of the street segments and access points specified above that would examine traffic incident data and provide recommendations related to enhancing roadway design and striping, specifically at the intersection of East 114th Street and Wilmington Avenue, as well as explore the feasibility of implementing a full closure or one-way conversion of East 114th Street to prevent trucks from entering this narrow residential street. PRESENTED BY: TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District V SECONDED BY: JUN 3 0,2026
title: East 110th Street / Compton Avenue / Graham Avenue / East 111th Street / East 112th Street / Monitor Avenue / East 113th Street / 114th Street / Wilmington Avenue / Large Trucks Exceeding Maximum Gross Weight / Unlawful Use of Roadway
